notices.title: Spruce tree assets
notices.summary: The supplied spruce model, extracted images and derived bakes retain the source's stated CC0 dedication.
notices.text:
# Provided asset provenance

The source supplied in this conversation was Spruce.Tree.v6(1).glb.
SHA-256: 5c7cc423531752b5ef5459b3bb572133318064a986d4d259aa4b44c77490ee85
Its embedded metadata declares: "CC0 1.0 Universal dedication; see LICENSE.txt".
The generator is "Spruce v6 / open branchlet cutouts / CC0".

The packed original geometry, six extracted PNGs, new native view bakes and fitted
outlines are derived from that supplied source and retain those stated CC0 terms.
The distribution does not include a Godot executable, software Vulkan driver,
presentation bridge, font file, or third-party Python/C++ package.

notices.title: Character assets
notices.summary: Original character work is dedicated under CC0. The retained notice explains the inherited character source and the scope of that dedication.
notices.text:
BG5 Zombie Lab — CC0 1.0 Universal

SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0

To the extent possible under law, the contributors dedicate the newly authored
project code, test scene, zombie animation trajectories, material modifications,
mesh partitioning and cut-cap geometry in this delivery to the public domain
under the CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication.

You may copy, modify, distribute and use this original content, including for
commercial purposes, without asking permission. Attribution is appreciated
but is not required. The content is provided without warranty to the extent
permitted by law.

Full CC0 1.0 legal text:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode

INHERITED CHARACTER PROVENANCE

The character is based on assets/Human.realistic.glb in the user-supplied
FirstPersonLab.r3(1).zip. That source identifies its content as CC0-1.0 and
states that its base geometry and textures retain the provenance of the
original user-supplied asset. This derivative retains that provenance; this
dedication grants only rights held by the contributors to this delivery.

Source GLB SHA-256:
667f7746d21cd19db6b2c796a2e9b741269312265cbdf7f14a8e3c799f7914e2

No external models, texture packs, animation packs, motion capture, add-ons or
third-party Python libraries were added. Blender's bundled APIs, Godot's built-in
features and Python's standard library were used for authoring and validation.

Godot and Blender are separate software products. Their licenses continue to
apply to those applications; neither application is distributed in this archive.

notices.title: Inherited terrain textures
notices.summary: These inherited textures retain their source terms. The supplied note does not establish a new 0BSD or CC0 grant; consult the original asset metadata before reusing them separately.
notices.text:
# Texture provenance note

The four image files in this folder were reused from the user's existing terrain-texture assets available in this workspace:

- `grass_albedo.png`
- `gravel_albedo.png`
- `sand_albedo.jpg`
- `snow_albedo.png`

No new third-party source or license assertion is made by RayCell Terrain v0.1.7. Keep the original source/license metadata that belongs to the user's asset set when these textures are moved into another project.

notices.title: Godot logo and boot artwork
notices.summary: Godot logo by Andrea Calabró. The original artwork is centered at native size; TerraForest adds its own footer. Attribution and the license link follow.
notices.text:
Godot Engine Logo
Copyright (c) 2017 Andrea Calabró

This work is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license (CC BY 4.0 International): https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Source artwork: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/main/splash.png
